exemple: I get up at seven. I have breakfast in the kitchen.
regle: **La journée** : wake up, get up, have breakfast, go to school, have lunch, do my homework, go to bed. **La maison** : kitchen, bedroom, living-room, bathroom, garden.
piege: Have ne veut pas toujours dire avoir : have breakfast, c’est prendre le petit-déjeuner.

essai.consigne: Que veut dire « to go to bed » ?
